body:
## Summary

This PR unifies the dashboard's UI component system, fixes tracking functionality, and adds a comprehensive code review prompt for the entire project.

## Changes

### UI Component Unification
- Migrated all dashboard pages (Dashboard, Shipments, Analytics, Customers, Exceptions, Finance, Settings) to canonical Card/Button/Table components
- Added reusable PageHeader component (components/ui/page-header.tsx)
- Refactored away from deprecated CyberComponents.tsx usage
- Consistent Material Design principles across all pages

### Tracking Feature Fixes
- Fixed tracking service column names in lib/tracking-service.ts
- Improved transport mode icons in tracking components
- Enhanced light theme visibility for TrackingResultCard
- Fixed navbar smooth scroll navigation via logo
- Updated tracking-section.tsx and tracking-result-card.tsx

### Code Review
- Added CODE_REVIEW_PROMPT.md with comprehensive review checklist

### Component Cleanup
- Updated button.tsx and card.tsx for consistency
- Cleaned up hero-section.tsx and navbar.tsx

## Files Changed
| Area | Files |
|------|-------|
| Dashboard Pages | Analytics.tsx, Customers.tsx, Dashboard.tsx, Exceptions.tsx, Finance.tsx, Settings.tsx, Shipments.tsx |
| Landing Components | hero-section.tsx, navbar.tsx, tracking-result-card.tsx, tracking-section.tsx |
| UI Components | button.tsx, card.tsx, CyberComponents.tsx, page-header.tsx (new) |
| Services | tracking-service.ts |
| Docs | CODE_REVIEW_PROMPT.md (new) |

## Review Notes
- Large refactor touching many files - please review each component area independently
- No breaking changes to functionality
- Light theme improvements visible in tracking result card

## Summary by Sourcery

Unify dashboard and landing UI components around the canonical design system, enhance tracking visuals and behavior, and introduce a reusable page header along with a comprehensive code review prompt document.

New Features:
- Add a reusable PageHeader component to provide consistent titles, descriptions, and action areas across dashboard pages.
- Introduce an optional close affordance on the tracking result card and support for differentiating air versus truck shipments in tracking visuals and copy.
- Add a comprehensive CODE_REVIEW_PROMPT.md to guide deep, systematic reviews of the entire TAC Portal codebase.

Bug Fixes:
- Correct tracking service field mappings to use receiver fields and shipment mode, ensuring accurate tracking data and transport mode handling.
- Fix landing navbar logo behavior to smoothly scroll back to the hero section instead of performing a full route change.

Enhancements:
- Standardize multiple dashboard pages (Dashboard, Shipments, Customers, Finance, Settings, Exceptions, Analytics) on shared layout primitives like PageHeader, Tabs, Card, and CrudTable for a more cohesive UI.
- Refine card, button, and tracking result card styling for better light theme contrast, consistent typography, and more polished status and map visuals.
- Improve the exceptions workflow with stronger default form values, select-based inputs, toast-based error feedback, and clearer resolution summaries.
- Deprecate the legacy CyberComponents module in favor of re-exporting canonical UI components while maintaining backward compatibility.

Documentation:
- Document a detailed, multi-area code review checklist in CODE_REVIEW_PROMPT.md covering architecture, security, performance, UX, testing, and Supabase migrations.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Reusable PageHeader added and used across pages.
  * Tracking card: optional close control and carrier type display (AIR/TRUCK).
  * Settings converted to a tabbed interface (GENERAL, SECURITY, AUDIT).
  * New user roles for warehouse, operations, and finance with corresponding permissions.

* **UI / Style**
  * Consistent headers, shorter fade animations, refined card/button/badge visuals, smoother in-page home navigation.

* **Documentation**
  * Comprehensive code review and report documents added.

* **Refactor**
  * UI components consolidated to canonical exports for compatibility.

* **Tests**
  * E2E suites now gate runs by credentials and reorganize manifest workflows.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
